images.caption: Mount Carmel's southwest face, seen from near Kibbutz Ma'agan Michael on the coastal plain; a New Testament textbook supplement suggests the range may sometimes have been called "Mount Megiddo," a possible origin for "Har-Magedon" in Revelation 16:16.
